info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cheque Lock Box Management API
info.description: The Cheque Lock Box Management API enables users to efficiently modify and update the details of cheque lock box services. This API supports operations such as adjusting service parameters and enhancing customer settings, ensuring that clients can manage their banking services effectively. Typical consumers include banking institutions and financial services providers looking to streamline their trade banking functionalities. The API facilitates seamless integration and offers a reliable way to maintain up-to-date cheque lock box information.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific cheque lock box identified by its resource ID. Ensure that you provide all necessary information in the request body to make the required changes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the cheque lock box with the specified identifier. It allows for the modification of certain attributes or settings associated with the cheque lock box. Ensure that the required fields are included in the request according to the defined schema.
